model.name: cranial-unet-v2
model.input: binary defective-skull mask resampled to 2 mm isotropic, 128^3

training_data: SkullBreak parietotemporal, synthetic defects: 91 training subjects, 23 validation subjects (split_v2.csv)
limitation: Trained on synthetic parietotemporal defects. Other defect types and real patient scans have no measured accuracy. Not a clinical design.
